decisions.reason: As a plugin tied to the established map.apps offer with its own page and several public releases, it reflects visible commitment and ongoing development that management would be reluctant to reverse quickly.

Although public commitment appears weaker than for some other launches, it is still close to the core web-map business, so escalation of commitment and low strategic distance support keeping it for now.
Its home-page promotion and clear mobile-use improvement make it a visibly backed extension of the core portfolio, which management is likely to continue rather than withdraw after launch.

A software platform for building GIS solutions is strategically central, likely required substantial development effort, and fits the firm’s stated direction, so management would strongly tend to persist with it.
Mobile field data capture is close to the firm’s established geospatial solutions and had a dedicated product page, indicating enough investment and market commitment to favor retention.
This search extension sits close to the established web-map application stack and was presented on its own page, so management would more likely continue supporting it than admit an early mistake.
